title: The Machine of the Kuiper Line
author: Tamsin Galloway
blurb: Orsen Coldharbour, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
